blurb: Guests captain their own wood-fired hot tub boats on Lake Union, enjoying a full immersion in fresh, chemical-free water heated by a wood stove. The boats are electric-powered, ultra-stable, and designed for up to six people. Amenities include towels, waterproof phone cases, a bluetooth speaker, drinking water, and heated changing rooms.

quotes.text: Loved our trip… Being able to bring our own beverages, plus hop out of the boat and swim in the brisk lake made the experience even better….
…Being in a hot tub in the middle of the lake is surreal, and our timing for both sunset & moonrise was incredible.
Without question, one of the highlights of our lives. The sunset, the moon and the city skyline were breathtaking!
A MUST DO in Seattle! The staff was great, ready to help us, and laughed at all of our jokes!
I loved every minute of this experience! The views were spectacular!
